question: The largest employer in India int he organised sector is/are:
solution:
The correct answer is **__The Ind__ian Railways.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian Railways** has the largest employer in India 
 
• According to the latest data released by the **World Economic Forum**, Indian **Railways has approximately 1.5 million active employees in India.**
 
• **Indian Railways manages** the **fourth-largest railway network** in the world by size, with a route **length of 67,956 km as of 31 March 2020. **
 
• Indian Railways was founded on **16 April 1853.**
 
• **The first train** in India ran between **Bori Bunder (Bombay) and Thane, **a distance of** 34 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Minister of Railways - Shri Ashwini Vaishnaw.
 
• CEO of Railways - VK Tripathi.
 
• The United States has the world's largest railway network.
 
• On September 27, 1825 **world's first train **ran between Stockton and Darlington.
